title: CAMERA: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV by CHASE, occasionally propped on…
content:
CAMERA: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV by CHASE, occasionally propped on vanity. Natural shake, imperfect framing, delayed focus, clumsy zooms, face occasionally cropped. Camera never visible.

LOOK: Soft blurry tape, faint tape noise, bloomed vanity bulbs, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, natural skin.

STYLE: Casual beauty vlog. Relaxed, chatty, slow pacing with quiet mirror moments.

CHARACTER: CHASE, Korean idol (20s), long straight black hair, dewy skin, coral lips, robe/makeup cape. Unseen stylist's hands occasionally enter frame.

SETTING: Bulb-lit vanity, styling chair, hair tools/products on counter, handheld mirror.

STORYBOARD:
1. Propped: Waves. "Hey guys, getting my hair done."
2. Handheld CU: Hair tug. "This always takes forever."
3. Insert: Stylist clips hair. Ambient only.
4. Propped: Smiles. "We're getting to the good part."
5. Handheld CU: Watches mirror, smiles. Ambient.
6. Handheld: Checks back with mirror. "Let me see the back—"
7. Tight: Grins. "I really like this."
8. Selfie: Waves/thumbs up. "Hair's done—see you guys!"

CÁMARA: videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm, POV en mano por CHASE, ocasionalmente apoyada sobre el tocador. Temblor natural, encuadre imperfecto, enfoque retrasado, zooms torpes, el rostro a veces recortado. La cámara nunca es visible.

LOOK: cinta suave y borrosa, leve ruido de cinta, luces del tocador con bloom, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, piel natural.

STYLE: vlog de belleza casual. Relajado, conversacional, ritmo lento con momentos tranquilos frente al espejo.

CHARACTER: CHASE, ídolo coreano (20s), cabello largo y liso negro, piel luminosa, labios coral, bata/capa de maquillaje. Las manos del estilista, fuera de cuadro, ocasionalmente entran en plano.

SETTING: tocador iluminado con bombillas, silla de peinado, herramientas/productos para el cabello sobre la encimera, espejo de mano.

STORYBOARD:
1. Apoyada: ondas. "Hey guys, getting my hair done."
2. Primer plano en mano: tirón del cabello. "This always takes forever."
3. Inserto: el estilista sujeta el cabello con clips. Solo ambiente.
4. Apoyada: sonríe. "We're getting to the good part."
5. Primer plano en mano: mira el espejo, sonríe. Ambiente.
6. En mano: revisa la parte de atrás con el espejo. "Let me see the back—"
7. Plano corto: sonríe ampliamente. "I really like this."
8. Selfie: saluda/hace pulgar arriba. "Hair's done—see you guys!"

fr.content:
CAMÉRA : Caméscope DV 16 mm, POV à main levée par CHASE, parfois posé sur la coiffeuse. Tremblements naturels, cadrage imparfait, mise au point retardée, zooms maladroits, visage parfois coupé. La caméra n’est jamais visible.

LOOK : Image douce et floue comme une bande, léger bruit de bande, ampoules de coiffeuse surexposées, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué, peau naturelle.

STYLE : Vlog beauté décontracté. Ton relax, bavard, rythme lent avec des moments calmes devant le miroir.

CHARACTER : CHASE, idole coréenne (20 ans), longs cheveux noirs raides, peau lumineuse, lèvres corail, robe/cape de maquillage. Les mains du/de la styliste hors champ entrent parfois dans le cadre.

SETTING : Coiffeuse éclairée par des ampoules, chaise de coiffure, outils/produits capillaires sur le comptoir, miroir à main.

STORYBOARD :
1. Posé : Ondulations. « Salut tout le monde, je me fais coiffer. »
2. Gros plan à main levée : Tiraillement des cheveux. « Ça prend toujours une éternité. »
3. Insert : Le/la styliste clipse les cheveux. Ambiance uniquement.
4. Posé : Sourit. « On arrive à la bonne partie. »
5. Gros plan à main levée : Regarde dans le miroir, sourit. Ambiance.
6. À main levée : Vérifie l’arrière avec le miroir. « Laisse-moi voir l’arrière — »
7. Serré : Sourit largement. « J’aime vraiment ça. »
8. Selfie : Fait signe de la main / pouce levé. « Les cheveux sont faits — à plus, les gars ! »

SETTING: 電球で照らされたドレッサー、スタイリングチェア、カウンター上のヘアツール／製品、手鏡。

ko.content:
CAMERA: DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더, CHASE의 핸드헬드 POV, 가끔 화장대에 기대어 고정. 자연스러운 흔들림, 완벽하지 않은 구도, 지연되는 초점, 서툰 줌, 얼굴이 가끔 잘림. 카메라는 절대 보이지 않음.

LOOK: 부드럽고 흐릿한 테이프 질감, 은은한 테이프 노이즈, 번진 화장대 전구빛, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 낮은 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤.

STYLE: 캐주얼한 뷰티 브이로그. 편안하고 수다스러우며, 느린 템포와 조용한 거울 장면.

CHARACTER: CHASE, 한국 아이돌(20대), 길고 곧은 검은 머리, 촉촉한 피부, 코럴 립, 로브/메이크업 케이프. 보이지 않는 스타일리스트의 손이 가끔 프레임 안으로 들어옴.

SETTING: 전구 조명이 비추는 화장대, 스타일링 의자, 카운터 위의 헤어 도구/제품, 핸드헬드 거울.

STORYBOARD:
1. 기대어 둔 샷: 웨이브. "Hey guys, getting my hair done."
2. 핸드헬드 CU: 머리카락을 잡아당김. "This always takes forever."
3. 인서트: 스타일리스트가 머리핀을 꽂음. 주변 소리만.
4. 기대어 둔 샷: 미소. "We're getting to the good part."
5. 핸드헬드 CU: 거울을 보며 미소. 주변 소리.
6. 핸드헬드: 거울로 뒤를 확인함. "Let me see the back—"
7. 타이트 샷: 활짝 웃음. "I really like this."
8. 셀피: 손을 흔들거나 엄지 척. "Hair's done—see you guys!"

pt.content:
CAMERA: Filmadora DV de fita 16mm, POV na mão por CHASE, ocasionalmente apoiada na penteadeira. Tremor natural, enquadramento imperfeito, foco com atraso, zooms desajeitados, rosto ocasionalmente cortado. A câmera nunca aparece.

LOOK: Fita suave e borrada, leve ruído de fita, luzes da penteadeira estouradas, autoexposição piscando, contraste suave, pele natural.

STYLE: Vlog casual de beleza. Relaxado, conversado, ritmo lento com momentos tranquilos diante do espelho.

CHARACTER: CHASE, idol coreano (20 e poucos anos), cabelo preto longo e liso, pele viçosa, lábios coral, robe/capa de maquiagem. As mãos do(a) stylist, fora de quadro, entram ocasionalmente na cena.

SETTING: Penteadeira iluminada por lâmpadas, cadeira de styling, ferramentas/produtos de cabelo sobre o balcão, espelho de mão.

STORYBOARD:
1. Apoiada: Ondas. "Hey guys, getting my hair done."
2. CU na mão: Puxão no cabelo. "This always takes forever."
3. Inserção: Stylist prende o cabelo com presilhas. Som ambiente apenas.
4. Apoiada: Sorrisos. "We're getting to the good part."
5. CU na mão: Olha no espelho, sorri. Ambiente.
6. Na mão: Confere a parte de trás com o espelho. "Let me see the back—"
7. Close: Sorri de orelha a orelha. "I really like this."
8. Selfie: Acena/faz joinha. "Hair's done—see you guys!"

zh.content:
CAMERA：DV 16mm 磁带摄像机，由 CHASE 手持 POV 拍摄，偶尔架在梳妆台上。自然抖动，构图不完美，对焦延迟，笨拙的变焦，脸部偶尔被裁切。镜头始终不可见。

LOOK：柔和模糊的磁带质感，轻微磁带噪点，梳妆台灯泡高光泛光，自动曝光轻微闪烁，低饱和对比度，自然肤色。

STYLE：轻松的美妆 vlog。氛围放松、健谈、节奏缓慢，带有安静的镜前时刻。

CHARACTER：CHASE，韩国偶像（20 多岁），黑色长直发，水润肌肤，珊瑚色唇妆，穿着浴袍/化妆披肩。看不见的造型师的手偶尔进入画面。

SETTING：灯泡照明的梳妆台、造型椅、台面上的美发工具/产品、手持镜子。

STORYBOARD：
1. 架起：挥手。“嘿，大家，我在做头发。”
2. 手持特写：头发被拉扯。“这个总是要花很久。”
3. 插入镜头：造型师夹起头发。仅环境音。
4. 架起：微笑。“快到精彩部分了。”
5. 手持特写：看着镜子，微笑。环境音。
6. 手持：拿镜子回看后面。“让我看看后面——”
7. 近景：咧嘴笑。“我真的很喜欢这个。”
8. 自拍：挥手/竖起大拇指。“头发做好啦——回头见，大家！”
